question: In which of the following years was the Child Marriage Restraint Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1929**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Child Marriage Restraint Act** was passed in the year **1929**.
 
• This act is also known as the **Sarda Act**, named after Harbilas Sarda, who introduced it.
 
• The act aimed to restrain the practice of child marriage in India by setting the minimum age of marriage to 18 for males and 14 for females.
 
• It was a significant step towards improving the social condition of women and children in India.
 
• The act has been amended several times, with the most recent amendments raising the minimum age of marriage to 21 for males and 18 for females.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Child Marriage Restraint Act** was a pioneering law for its time, addressing a deeply rooted social issue.
 
• Despite the enactment of the law, child marriage continues to be a challenge in many parts of India, necessitating ongoing efforts and enforcement.
 
• The act was one of the early legal reforms in India aimed at improving the status of women and children.
 
• Subsequent laws like the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 have further strengthened the legal framework against child marriage in India.
